Can I get same-day delivery?

Yes, for selected ready-to-send gifts in Kampala when ordered before 2 PM. Cakes and custom packages may need more time.

Can the delivery be a surprise?

Yes. Select the surprise option at checkout and we’ll contact you before reaching the recipient.

How do I pay?

After your WhatsApp order is confirmed, we’ll share the available mobile money or bank payment details. Read our secure payment guide.

Can I order for a company?

Yes. We prepare client, team and end-of-year packages in quantity. Contact us for a custom quote.
